title: Oak
body:
Oak Tree

The Oak Tree is a tree found in Finlay Island and Ferwater Island at the Grasslands, Farlands, and the Savannah. Other trees that can be found with this tree include Spruce, Birch, Red Maple, and Acacia. Its characteristics include a medium-brown bark, green leaves, and a beige wood. Like all trees, ores, and rocks, the Oak Tree can be used for filling schematics and blueprints.

Selling Price

The selling price of Oak trees (raw, sanded, and planked) can vary day to day. See the stock market located in the Resource Hub to see the exact price of Oak on a particular day. The price listed on the wiki is the default price for selling raw or processed Oak.

  • Logged (Raw) - $1.14/stud.
  • Sanded - $14/stud.
  • Planked - $17.5/stud.

Foraging

Oak Trees offer several forageable items, including the following:

  • Acorns, common rarity, on Oak tree leaves.
  • Apples, common rarity, on Oak tree leaves.
  • Agaric Mushrooms, common rarity, on Oak tree bark.
  • Daedalea Mushrooms, common rarity, on Oak tree bark.
  • Beehives, uncommon rarity, on Oak tree leaves.
  • Golden Apples, rare rarity, 1/1000 or 0.1% chance on Oak tree leaves.

Accessibility

Certain trees require specific conditions to obtain them, whether it be a specific axe or a weather condition. Detailed spawn conditions and other concerns (such as the relative difficulty of farming this tree) are also listed in the following:

  • Oak is a common rarity tree.
  • Can be logged using the Rusty Axe or higher.
  • Can be sanded using the Rusty Sander or higher.
  • Can be planked using the Steel Planker or higher.
  • Oak spawn conditions include the following:
    • Oak trees must spawn on the surface.
    • Oak trees must spawn on grass.
    • Oak trees are localized to Finlay, Flowering Meadows, and the entrance to Ferwater.
    • An Oak tree forest called "Mythril Forest" spawns Oak trees in large clusters; it is located in Finlay.

Trivia

  • This tree can be considered common due to the difficulty level of obtaining.
  • The Oak Tree was added during base game development.
  • The Internal Name is called "ExampleTree," as it most likely used as an example model for other trees. This can be seen if the Statistic Tool is used on a schematic of Oak.
